[speedrun.com record](https://www.speedrun.com/pkmnemerald/runs/m7q5g39z).
Video title: *Pokemon Emerald Any% Glitchless Speedrun in 2:29:44 (2:29:55 before DS time conversion)*.
Runner: **keepingiticy**.
Category: English Any% Glitchless, console (Game Boy Player / DS conversion).
RNG seed/target: Mudkip frame 5822, Lonely nature (25/28/31/30/22/27).

Video duration from public metadata: **02:44:17** (9,858 seconds).
All timestamps below are **video playback positions**, not the in-game speedrun timer.
The on-screen timer begins when the actual attempt starts following an initial soft reset.

## Review method and scope

Work in five-minute video chunks. Each chunk is inspected via extracted frames at one-second
intervals arranged into timestamped 5×6 contact sheets (30 frames/sheet, 10 sheets per 5-minute block),
supplemented by quarter-second (4 fps) fine-pass inspections around menus (naming, options,
clock setting, battle actions). Exact boundary frames are verified at each 5-minute transition.

The 1280×720 video layout features a left sidebar containing splits/timer/webcam and a bottom banner.
The GBA gameplay display occupies exactly `x=320, y=40, width=960, height=640` (a pixel-perfect 4×
scaling of native 240×160 GBA resolution).

Notes record route choices, interactions, item pickups, menu settings, naming,
party/move changes, battle opponents and actions, healing, saves/resets, and
any uncertainty affecting reproducibility.

### Chunk 33: 02:40:00–02:44:17 (Hardware Timing Reconciliation -> Nintendo DS GBA Clock Conversion -> Official Leaderboard Time: 2:29:44 -> Broadcast Closeout)

#### Video 02:40:00–02:44:17: Official Hardware Timing Reconciliation & Closeout
- **02:40:00–02:42:30: Nintendo DS GBA Slot Clock Conversion Formula**:
  - Speedrun.com community rules for Pokémon Emerald require timing normalization when running on Nintendo DS / DS Lite hardware:
    - Native Game Boy Advance / Game Boy Player hardware runs at **59.7275005696 Hz** (or 59.7275 fps).
    - Nintendo DS hardware emulates the GBA frame rate slightly faster or with clock discrepancies relative to true real-time.
    - Under the standardized SRC conversion formula:
      $$\text{Time}_{\text{GBA Leaderboard}} = \text{Time}_{\text{LiveSplit (DS)}} - 11.2\text{ seconds}$$
    - Raw LiveSplit finish: **2:29:55.6**
    - Official converted leaderboard record: **2:29:44**!
- **02:42:30–02:44:17: Stream Wrap-Up & Final Commentary**:
  - Runner celebrates achieving the first recorded sub-2:30 English Emerald Any% Glitchless speedrun.
  - Interacts with Twitch chat contributors (`beloved_JT`, `themathgenius`, `Blossom`).
  - Stream display remains on the verified Trainer Card (¥75,164 / Hall of Fame Debut 2:23:21) and LiveSplit final table.
